novelty.justification: The core novelty route is a new mechanistic relationship: the claim predicts that "the number and representational proximity of 'competitor' facts" determines recall failure and that known-but-wrong outputs are "intrusions of a nearby competitor," rather than merely studying another factual-recall setting. Searches using “LLM parametric fact-fact interference,” “factual recall competitor intrusion,” “representational crowding factual knowledge,” and “competing stored facts activation suppression” found the closest work in Geva et al., Dissecting Recall of Factual Associations in Auto-Regressive Language Models (2023), which shows relation-guided extraction from multiple subject attributes, plus work on contextual conflicts and edit-time interference, but none establishes retrieval-time competition among unedited, co-stored facts as the source of specific errors. Moving from those studies to a proximity-weighted competitor mechanism that predicts individual failures and supports competitor-specific suppression requires a new core relationship, not a direct transfer, although it remains within the established factual-recall and activation-intervention framework rather than creating a new paradigm.
